# create-vllnt-app

> Opinionated CLI for scaffolding agent-first web (Next.js), mobile (Expo), and fullstack monorepo projects with Convex backend. Ships AI agent contracts (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, .windsurfrules) and feature-sliced architecture out of the box.

## Quick Start

Install and scaffold a new project:

```
npx create-vllnt-app@latest
npx create-vllnt-app@latest --template web
npx create-vllnt-app@latest --template mobile
npx create-vllnt-app@latest --template fullstack
```

## Commands

- `vllnt new [name]`: Scaffold a new project from template
- `vllnt add <feature>`: Add integrations (auth, payments, analytics)
- `vllnt generate <type> <name>`: Generate pages, features, components, hooks, Convex domains
- `vllnt doctor`: Health check for vllnt project

## Templates

- **web**: Next.js 16 + Convex + Tailwind v4 + next-intl + @vllnt/ui
- **mobile**: Expo 55 + Convex + React Native + i18next + Maestro E2E
- **fullstack**: Turborepo monorepo with shared Convex backend, web + mobile apps

## Agent Mode

For AI coding agents and CI/CD pipelines:

```
npx create-vllnt-app@latest --agent --template web
```

Returns JSON: `{ success, path, template, files[], packageManager }`

Set `VLLNT_AGENT=1` to suppress interactive output.

## Ecosystem Packages

- [@vllnt/ui](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vllnt/ui): 93 React components (Radix UI + Tailwind + CVA)
- [@vllnt/eslint-config](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vllnt/eslint-config): Strict ESLint config for TypeScript
- [@vllnt/typescript](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vllnt/typescript): Shared TypeScript configurations
- [@vllnt/logger](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vllnt/logger): Structured logging
- [@vllnt/analytics](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vllnt/analytics): Privacy-first analytics with consent management
